package v1

import (
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

type Router struct {
	handler *handlers.StatHandler
}

func NewRouter(handler *handlers.StatHandler) *Router {
	return &Router{handler: handler}
}

func (r *Router) Register(e *echo.Echo, g *echo.Group) {
	stat := g.Group("/stat")
	stat.POST("/session/start", r.handler.StartSession)
	stat.POST("/events", r.handler.PostEvents)
	stat.GET("/summary/task/:task_id", r.handler.GetTaskSummary)
	stat.GET("/summary/tasks", r.handler.ListTaskSummaries)
	stat.GET("/summary/session/:session_id", r.handler.GetLearningSessionSummary)

	// WebSocket endpoint mounted separately from the versioned HTTP base path.
	e.GET("/ws/v1/stat/events", r.handler.EventsWS)
}
